note: Runs the optimizer for the chosen mode (default balanced), reserves capacity with a lease per GPU (conditional write in ms-router-orders, or SQLite locally), and starts one orchestration per order (Step Functions Standard, or in-process when ORCHESTRATOR=local): pay, dispatch, wait for completion, settle. Payment on XRPL devnet: the buyer pays the quoted total in TDX to the Moonshift order treasury, memo MS_ORDER {orderId, mode}. On completion the router pays each GPU's Moonshift treasury (external capacity: the external-capacity treasury) for the work it actually served, memo MS_SETTLE {orderId, gpuId, tokensOrMinutes}, and refunds the unused amount. Inference orders carry requests (one list of chat messages each); rental orders book minutes through compute's booking route. Responds once paid. Header X-MS-Internal-Key when INTERNAL_API_KEY is set.

errors.NO_FEASIBLE_PLAN: 409, nothing meets the deadline, budget and constraints in this mode
errors.CAPACITY_TAKEN: 409, another order took the slot between quote and order; quote again
errors.PAYMENT_FAILED: 502, the devnet payment did not validate; leases are released
